race.title: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: This looks a fine opportunity for GUNNERY SERGEANT to finally get off the mark in a thin race. Beeverstown Boy can chase the selection home, whilst Flashy Fred 's bumper form would entitle him to be in the mix. GUNNERY SERGEANT (FR) BEEVERSTOWN BOY (FR) FLASHY FRED (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Gunnery Sergeant (6/4), Beeverstown Boy (5/2), Kiltinan (7/2), Flashy Fred (4/1), Quarry Road (16/1), Bayswater Bloom (33/1), Two Pats (50/1), Vango At Dawn (50/1), Potters Queen (66/1), Soldier Power (66/1), George Dundee (100/1), Long Story (100/1)
